seo.title: MySQL and MariaDB client for {devices}
seo.description: Connect to MySQL and MariaDB with SSH, SSL/TLS or AWS IAM, and to TiDB, OceanBase and Databend on the same driver. EXPLAIN diagrams and mysqldump backups.

header.title: MySQL and MariaDB client
header.lead: Query MySQL and MariaDB, edit rows, and manage users, sessions and backups from the same connection.

bands.title: Connect
text: Enter a host, port and user, or paste a mysql:// URL; MySQL 8 caching_sha2_password accounts are supported. The database is optional, and switching databases keeps the same connection.

New connections start with SSL set to Preferred, which falls back to plain text only after a failed TLS handshake. Choose Verify CA or Verify Identity with your provider’s certificate for strict checking. Amazon RDS and Aurora sign in with <cloudAuth>AWS IAM</cloudAuth>, with a fresh token on each connection, and <importApps>Import from Other App</importApps> reads Sequel Ace favorites.

bands.title: Query and edit
text: View <explain>EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON, EXPLAIN FORMAT=TREE and EXPLAIN ANALYZE</explain> as diagrams or trees, and compare two plans. Saves stop on unexpected row counts, and a table without a primary key is edited by matching every column.

Every session uses utf8mb4, so emoji and non-Latin text round-trip. For text an old client wrote through Latin 1, the UTF-8 via Latin 1 encoding reads it the way that client did. Partitions list their bounds, such as VALUES LESS THAN (2024), and comments show in the sidebar and the column headers.

bands.title: Schema
text: Stage columns, indexes, foreign keys, CHECK constraints and generated columns in the <structure>Structure tab</structure>; expression index keys need MySQL 8.0.13 or later. Routines and triggers appear in the sidebar with their source.
<compareSync>Compare & Sync</compareSync> ({compareSyncTier}) compares MySQL or MariaDB schemas or data and holds back changes that could remove data until you include them.

bands.title: Administer
text: Users & Roles lists privileges down to single columns. The Server Dashboard lists sessions, server metrics and slow queries, and cancels a query with KILL QUERY or ends a session with KILL; an account without the PROCESS privilege sees only its own sessions. Table maintenance shows OPTIMIZE, ANALYZE, CHECK and REPAIR TABLE before they run.

<backup>Backup Dump</backup> runs {dumpTool} and Restore Dump runs the mysql client through the connection’s SSH tunnel, once the MySQL client tools are on your Mac. A restore replaces the objects the dump names.

family.title: MariaDB
text: MariaDB connects through the MySQL driver with the same SSH, SSL/TLS and AWS IAM options, and a mariadb:// URL creates a MariaDB connection. JSON columns, which MariaDB stores as LONGTEXT, open in the JSON editor; virtual and persistent columns stay out of generated INSERT and UPDATE statements, and sequences are listed read-only.
Users & Roles, the Server Dashboard, table maintenance and {dumpTool} backups work as they do on MySQL.

family.title: TiDB
text: Point the connection at a TiDB server’s SQL port, never at PD or TiKV, and choose TiDB as the connection type so the sidebar, the type picker and EXPLAIN follow TiDB. On TiDB Cloud, set SSL Mode to Required.

Stop sends KILL TIDB QUERY, which behind TiProxy or a load balancer needs Global Kill, on by default since TiDB 6.1. EXPLAIN shows the plan as text, and Users & Roles works without the connection limit field.

family.title: OceanBase
text: Put the tenant in the user name: root@test on an observer, or root@test#obcluster through OBProxy, which listens on port 2883. Choose OceanBase as the connection type: connecting checks that the server reports itself as OceanBase, so a wrong host or port fails at once.
EXPLAIN shows the plan as text, TablePro’s query timeout replaces OceanBase’s own statement limit, and a save that would change more than one row, or none, stops and says so.

family.title: Databend
text: Databend connects through its MySQL handler, not its HTTP API. Choose Databend as the connection type: a MySQL connection that reaches a Databend server is refused. On Databend Cloud, ask Databend support to turn on the warehouse’s MySQL endpoint, then copy the host and port from its Connect dialog.
The Structure tab edits columns and CHECK constraints and renames tables, views and columns. ARRAY, MAP and TUPLE cells change with an UPDATE in the editor.

moveData: <importData>Import</importData> {importFormats} files, and export tables or results as {exportFormats}. <copy>Copy To</copy> moves tables and their data to another MySQL connection or another engine.
iphone: Browse tables as cards, filter and sort them, edit rows that have a primary key and run SQL in the Query tab. Connections offer SSL from Required to Verify Identity, and SSH tunnels with a password or a key.

faq.question: Can TablePro connect through a local MySQL socket?
faq.answer: Yes, for a server on this Mac. Set <ui>Connect Using</ui> to <ui>Socket</ui> and enter the path of its socket file. Host and port leave the form, and an SSH tunnel cannot reach a socket file.

faq.question: Do I need the MySQL client tools installed?
faq.answer: Only for Backup Dump and Restore Dump, which run {dumpTool} and mysql. Connecting, querying and editing use the driver that comes with the app.

faq.question: Can I design a schema in the ER diagram?
faq.answer: No. The <erDiagram>ER diagram</erDiagram> is a read-only picture of the schema that you can export as PNG or SQL. Change tables in the Structure tab or with SQL.

otherTools.text: Sequel Ace keeps to MySQL and MariaDB on Mac, MySQL Workbench is Oracle’s own tool and phpMyAdmin runs on a web server; compare TablePro with <sequelAce>Sequel Ace</sequelAce>, <workbench>MySQL Workbench</workbench>, <phpmyadmin>phpMyAdmin</phpmyadmin> or <heidisql>HeidiSQL</heidisql>.
